queries: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS invoiced_orders FROM Invoices AS i JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), per_gender_average AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced_orders) AS average_invoiced_orders FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(gc.invoiced_orders) AS average_figure, AVG(gc.invoiced_orders - pga.average_invoiced_orders) AS average_excess FROM gender_counts AS gc CROSS JOIN per_gender_average AS pga WHERE gc.invoiced_orders > pga.average_invoiced_orders;

WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS invoiced_orders FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced_orders) AS avg_orders FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(g.invoiced_orders) AS average_invoiced_orders, AVG(g.invoiced_orders - a.avg_orders) AS average_excess FROM gender_counts g CROSS JOIN overall_average a WHERE g.invoiced_orders > a.avg_orders

assumptions.assumption: The per-gender average includes only genders with at least one invoiced order.

alternatives.interpretation: Include every gender present among customers, assigning zero invoiced orders to genders with none.
